name: Salt
overview: Scripture presents salt as a symbol of preservation, covenant, and purity. The salt sea and valley of salt mark geographical boundaries and settings of divine activity, as seen in Genesis 14:3 and Numbers 34:12. Salt’s sacred role is highlighted in Leviticus 2:13, where all offerings are to be seasoned with salt, and in Numbers 18:19, where the covenant of salt signifies an enduring divine agreement. The transformation of Lot’s wife into a pillar of salt (Genesis 19:26) underscores salt’s association with judgment and remembrance.
